title: 2017 AMC 12A Problem 11
statement: Claire adds the degree measures of the interior angles of a convex polygon and arrives at a sum of \(2017.\) She then discovers that she forgot to include one angle. What is the degree measure of the forgotten angle?

solutions.text:
If the polygon has \(n\) sides and the forgotten angle is \(\alpha,\) then \((n-2)180=2017+\alpha.\) Since \(0\lt\alpha\lt180,\) \[ 2017\lt(n-2)180\lt2197. \]

The only multiple of \(180\) in this range is \(2160=(14-2)180,\) so \(n=14\) and \[ \alpha=2160-2017=143. \]

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: The true angle sum \((n-2)\cdot180\) is a multiple of \(180\) just above \(2017\)
The forgotten angle is that multiple minus \(2017,\) and it must be less than \(180\)
